lines.say: Voice cloning in 646 languages, running fully on your own hardware.
VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully local ElevenLabs alternative.
You can clone a voice, or design your own by describing it.
It dubs videos with timed speech, and it turns stories into audiobooks and batch jobs.
You can dictate with a floating widget, and transcription is built in too.
The default engine is powered by k2-fsa OmniVoice, and you can choose another one.
Local workflows run on your hardware, and remote workers are optional.
It uses CUDA on an NVIDIA GPU and Metal on Apple Silicon, and without a dedicated GPU it still runs on the CPU, just slower.
Coding agents can drive it too, through a local API and MCP.
The repo has 55868 stars and 6265 forks.
On macOS or Linux, one curl command installs it, and on Windows a single PowerShell line does the same.
Save this for your next dubbing project.
